messages:
Jules (AE): Solaris (customer) wants to POC a new variant called `solaris-3b-q5b`. They're asking about catalog fit, kv-cache long-context handling, and an upfront POC price. Any blockers?
Riley (Solutions): Need model artifact + tokenizer + sample prompts. Also ask if they will run fine-tuning during POC. Sequence distribution?
Hana (Eng-ML): q5b is fine but we need to validate logits scaling and generation stability. Request a small eval set and golden outputs. Will do q5b vs f16 comparison.
Derek (Eng-Infra): runtime note: previous q5-like variants had sporadic KV serialization latency at >6k tokens under concurrency 4. We'll run targeted KV serialization stress. Need model config (n_ctx, rotary, dtype tags).
Pri (Security): Security intake required: model license, provenance, and confirmation about PII in prompts. If they upload PII we must enable CMK + ephemeral storage.
Marta (Product): Hosted POC vs Dedicated? Hosted faster; Dedicated gives KMS/audit features and predictable capacity. If Dedicated needed, lead time ~30d for GPUs.
Leo (Acct Exec): Ballpark Hosted POC (2 weeks) $1.8k-5k. Dedicated minimum month reserve ~ $22k. I'll prepare both stubs.
Jules (AE): I'll request artifact and 50 prompts (avg 500, some 2k). Can we do a tech kickoff Thurs 11am PT?
Derek (Eng-Infra): Thurs 11am PT works. I'll prepare runbook: tokenization sanity -> kv stress (2k/6k) -> perf bench (batch 1/4/8) -> fallback wiring to f16.
Hana (Eng-ML): I'll add a smoke test in eval harness: 20 prompts, similarity >=0.9 q5b->f16.
Pri (Security): Send them vendor questionnaire link and request licence + SPDX. If they insist on SSO/audit recommend Dedicated.
Riley (Solutions): Example command I'll run after artifact: `redwoodctl model scan ./solaris_bundle.tar --profile q5b --kv-check --seq 2048`
InfraBot: Ticket created: POC-4990 (solaris-3b-q5b onboarding), assignee: Riley (Solutions).
Jules (AE): Thanks team 44d. I'll compile checklist and invite people.
